name: sea hag
lore:
From the briny depths and shadowed coastlines emerge the sea hags, the most wretched of their kind. These denizens of the deep hold a special disdain for beauty, twisting hope into despair and courage into dread. Their lairs, often found in sunken shipwrecks or befouled shores, are as dismal as their own outlook, teeming with underwater horrors and a sense of encroaching doom. Woe betide those who stumble upon their domains, for the sea hag's gaze can wither the soul and her touch bring only ruin. 

Encountering a sea hag is more than a battle; it's a descent into madness. Their appearance alone can instill a crippling fear, and their twisted magic serves only to corrupt and destroy. They lurk in the murky depths, preying on the weak and unwary, their existence a testament to the darkness that festers beneath the waves. Beware the whisper of the tide, for it may carry the laughter of a sea hag, a chilling promise of the horrors to come.
